verdict.rationale: Limitless documents granular, permanent deletion through its API: lifelog entries are deleted along with all associated transcripts, audio and metadata, with no recovery, and Ask AI chats can also be deleted. The vendor also says users can delete all their data in the app and export everything first, which gives users real control over what is kept. Missing for 10: configurable automatic retention windows or auto-delete policies, documentation of server-side backup and purge timelines, and independent or hands-on confirmation that deletion works as described.
